answers.how: The boat moves approximately 47 px during the first second. Combining its 1.5 m travel with the supplied camera distances gives approximately 0.0143 m/px initially; its bow-to-stern span is about 136 px.
The boat's transverse width is approximately 49 px. Applying the motion-and-depth-calibrated scale of 0.0143 m/px gives 0.70 m.
The vertical hull span, excluding its reflection, is approximately 30 px; 30 × 0.0143 gives 0.43 m.
The pier measures approximately 40 px across its outer edge. Correcting the calibrated projection to the pier's camera distance gives approximately 0.0238 m/px.
Corresponding shore-side and water-side deck corners are approximately 168 px apart along the pier; the depth-adjusted scale is approximately 0.0238 m/px.

Extrapolating the boat's motion to 3 s gives a camera distance of approximately 15.90 m. Combining this with the pier's 18.920 m distance and the projected gap between their nearest edges gives approximately 3.35 m.
The wooden steps span approximately 48 px across. At their supplied camera distance, the calibrated scale is approximately 0.0293 m/px.
The pier deck stands approximately 24 px above the waterline at its outer supports; applying the pier's depth-adjusted scale gives 0.57 m.
The cabin floor is approximately 22 px above the ground beneath the front platform. Using the stairs' camera distance gives approximately 0.0293 m/px.
